description: Two nested, previously untested bar_a micro-refinements around every R7-D7 fixed-point kernel witness. Each level re-solves the full frozen-halo Bellman fixed point. Level A inserts +/- one base-cell width/32768; Level B additionally inserts +/- one base-cell width/65536. The audit tests center persistence, two-sided fixed-point persistence, structural gates, cross-level span drift, and an outward numerical pre-certificate margin. It does not yet authorize a theorem-level/maximal kernel claim.
